messages:
Maya Singh: Heads-up: canary wave (model-service v2.1-quant) in us-east-1 showing healthcheck failures and jump in 5xx across wave B. Console shows 5xx from ~0.6% to ~6.8% over 4m. Investigating now.
incident-bot: New incident created — severity: high. Pager: @Sahil Rao @Jordan Li. Incident link: https://internal.incidents/1768459999
Sahil Rao: I'm paged, starting log collection from canary nodes. grabbing runtime logs and dmesg.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started 00:04:20 ago: wave_id=B target_replicas=18. health_failed=4 total=18.
Jordan Li: Are these 500s from runtime or proxy 502/503? Any OOM patterns?
Sahil Rao: Initial grep: majority 500, a few 502 from sidecar disconnects. One host shows kernel OOM-killer lines.
Sahil Rao: snippet:
```
Feb 18 15:23:12 host-17 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 2345 (model_i) total-vm: 1580000kB
2026-02-18T15:23:13Z ERROR runtime: allocation failed, returning 500
2026-02-18T15:23:13Z INFO health: liveness probe failed
```
Maya Singh: Correlating with ML config: we shipped a new quantization profile (q8-variant) in this build. Hypothesis: increased peak memory for certain sharded layers leading to OOM on smaller instance types.
Emily Park: Customer impact: We see a spike in failed completions and p99 latency crawl for some orgs. CS ticket queue has two escalations (org A id O-7210, org B id O-3372). Not a platform-wide outage but visible for high-throughput tenants.
Jordan Li: Abort criteria hit per rollout policy: >=5% 5xx sustained 2m. Recommend hitting the rollout kill-switch and starting rollback of wave B immediately. Also limit autoscaler to prevent noisy upscaling while we stabilize.
Sahil Rao: I'll flip the flag and kick rollback. Command run:
```
featureflagctl set enable_model_v2_quant false --env=prod --actor=Sahil
```
featureflag-bot: enable_model_v2_quant set to false by Sahil Rao at 2026-02-18T15:27:41Z
deploy-bot: Canary expansion halted. Initiating automated rollback of wave B to v2.0 baseline.
Maya Singh: Good. Jordan — please patch HPA max replicas down to avoid scaling noise: kubectl patch hpa model-quant --patch '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":25}}'
Jordan Li: Patched HPA max to 25. Also marking 5 hosts from wave B for immediate manual rollback due to kernel OOM traces.
Sahil Rao: Rolling back those 5 nodes now. Watching metrics — 5xx rate dropping: 6.8% -> 2.3% within 90s. Latency trending down for affected tenants.
Emily Park: Notifying CS with standard incident template and ETA ~12m for full rollback. Opening postmortem ticket (PM-176845) and scheduling 45m triage.
Maya Singh: ML team: re-run quant profile unit tests and memory profiler. We should gate future quant builds with mem regression checks. Assigning @Jordan Li to verify SRE gating.
Jordan Li: Will add a gating checklist to the rollout pipeline and add an early-memory-smoke test that runs on a small instance matrix.
Sahil Rao: On-call handoff: my shift ends in 40m. Jordan, can you take watch and finish verification? I'll add notes to runbook and leave the rollback progress in the incident thread.
Jordan Li: Taking handoff if still active. Please leave any affected host IDs and short commands used.
Maya Singh: Incident status: mitigation in progress, rollout aborted, rollback underway, partial customer impact mitigated. Do not re-enable flag until ML sign-off and SRE verification. Postmortem required.
incident-bot: Incident updated — status: mitigated->monitoring. Severity reduced to medium. Follow-up: postmortem_required. Assigned: Sahil Rao, Jordan Li, Maya Singh, Emily Park.
Emily Park: I'll compile timeline and impact summary once rollback completes. Adding CS notes: orgs O-7210 and O-3372 notified, promise of follow-up within 2 business hours.
Maya Singh: Thanks all. Quick reminder — avoid re-running the canary with the same quant profile until we have a memory regression fix and a validated canary plan.
